clips.start_words: If you have a burning desire for something
clips.send: A friend who keeps saying they want something but never moves on it - a little recognition, a little shame, not cruel.
clips.caption:
Wanting it is not the same as burning for it.

A burning desire doesn't mean thinking about the goal every second — nobody does that, and you don't need to. What it actually does is harder to fake: it gets you up an hour early. It says no to the thing you don't need tonight. It moves your feet when nothing in you wants to move.

If your "desire" has never once made you do something you didn't feel like doing, it isn't burning. It's just a wish.

Comment RISE and I'll send you the rest of this.
